notes: Quebec is a civil law province. Affidavits (déclarations sous serment) follow a different tradition. Notaries (notaires) in Quebec have broader powers than in common-law provinces and may draft binding notarial acts. The family patrimony (patrimoine familial) regime is mandatory for all married couples — it requires equal division of certain designated assets regardless of ownership.
